flags: YEAR DISCREPANCY: parent task and project memory cited the GST cut as 22 Sep 2026; every sourced article (CarDekho, NewsBytes dated Sep 10, 2025, GaadiKey) dates VW's GST 2.0 announcement to early September 2025 with effect from 2025-09-22. Recorded 2025-09-22 (within window). No separate September 2026 GST revision could be sourced.

Jan 2026 revision: exact effective day not stated in sources; earliest coverage Jan 7, 2026 (blogspot repost of Autocar story), Times Now updated Jan 12, 2026. Used 2026-01-01, approximate, is_estimate=true.
Taigun facelift pricing news broke Apr 14, 2026 (Moneycontrol dateline 15:40 IST; Autocar image assets dated 20260414); Overdrive shows Apr 15, 2026 update. Used 2026-04-14.
is_estimate=true on every record: all figures are media-reported (Autocar India, CarDekho, GaadiWaadi, CarWale), not official VW press releases or official price lists.

GST-cut variant table (GaadiWaadi) 'new' prices differ slightly from v3cars tentative list (e.g. Taigun Comfortline 11.39L vs 11,39,300) and ackodrive (11,39,200), and from caronphone's stated late-2025 price (11.42L) — rounding/tentative differences; GaadiWaadi post-cut figures used.

Unmatched variant names kept with source wording: Taigun '1.5 TSI GT Plus Chrome MT'/'GT Plus Sport MT' (dropped from Apr 2026 facelift lineup); Virtus '1.5 TSI GT Plus Chrome MT'/'GT Plus Sport MT' and GST-table 'Virtus 1.5 TSI GT Plus MT Chrome/Sport' (no exact match in current verified list).

Mappings to verified variant names: Virtus 'GT Plus Chrome DCT' -> 'GT Plus DSG ES 1.5 TSI'; Virtus 'Topline MT'/'Topline AT' -> 'Topline ES 1.0 TSI'/'Topline AT ES 1.0 TSI' (ES = electric seats); 'GT-Line'/'GT Plus Chrome DSG' spellings normalized to 'GT Line'/'GT Plus Chrome 1.5 TSI DSG'.
gearchoice.in Virtus price-revision article (Comfortline -70,201, etc.) is undated and conflicts with caronphone/Autocar's Jan-2026 figures — excluded as unreliable.

No new nameplate, new generation, or EV derivative for taigun/virtus in window. Taigun GT Line (Apr 2024), Taigun/Virtus Highline Plus (Aug 2024) and Deep Black Pearl / Sound / Anniversary editions are ordinary variant additions or special editions — excluded per rules.
Prices are ex-showroom INR; GaadiKey's GST table explicitly labels ex-showroom Delhi; other sources do not specify city.

launches.notes: Facelift unveiled Apr 9, 2026; prices announced Apr 14, 2026. Entry Comfortline 1.0 TSI 6MT at Rs 10,99,900 ex-showroom; range Rs 10,99,900-19,29,900. New 8-speed torque-converter AT for 1.0 TSI (replacing 6-speed), rear disc brakes on higher variants, connected DRL strip, illuminated VW logos, 10.25-inch digital cluster, panoramic sunroof, 75% assured buyback for bookings before May 31, 2026.

model_notes.note: GST 2.0 rate cut effective 2025-09-22: Volkswagen passed the full benefit; Taigun prices cut by up to Rs 68,400 (45% -> 40% tax slab). Source: https://www.cardekho.com/news/general/volkswagen-gst-rate-cut-impact-taigun-virtus-cheaper-by-over-rs-65000-tiguan-gets-rs-327-lakh-price-drop-35018.htm

GST 2.0 rate cut effective 2025-09-22: Virtus prices cut by up to Rs 66,900. Source: https://www.cardekho.com/news/general/volkswagen-gst-rate-cut-impact-taigun-virtus-cheaper-by-over-rs-65000-tiguan-gets-rs-327-lakh-price-drop-35018.htm

April 2026 facelift dropped the 1.5 TSI manual variants (GT Plus Chrome MT and GT Plus Sport MT, priced at Rs 17.04L in Jan 2026); the 1.5 TSI is DSG-only in the facelift lineup. 1.0 TSI gained a new 8-speed torque-converter AT replacing the 6-speed unit.
Virtus facelift not launched as of 2026-10-12; only expected Oct/Nov 2026 (ZigWheels estimated launch Oct 25, 2026; CarWale says Nov 2026). No Virtus launch event in the research window.
